email.subject1: a signal play for Courier Health
email.body1:
Graham, saw Courier Health raised its $50M Series B and grew therapies supported over 400 percent last year.

Scaling that fast usually means more biopharma accounts in market than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Courier Health off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Graham, quick follow-up for Courier Health.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Courier Health needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Graham, last bit of proof for Courier Health.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Courier Health's reply rate likely compares to other Series-B health-tech startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?

Graham, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. The stretch right after a raise is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a Series-B health-tech motion? I'll tailor it to Courier Health either way.
